name: Salt Fish
desc: Cheap and plentiful. Hungry ports pay a little more.

name: Cotton Bales
desc: Raw fibre from the inland fields, wanted by every loom-town.

name: Hardwood
desc: Keel-grade timber. Shipyards cannot get enough.

name: Cocoa Beans
desc: Bitter beans that turn into sweet profit.

name: Spice Chests
desc: Pepper, clove and mace from distant traders.

name: Muskets
desc: Governors pay well. Pirates pay better.

name: Fine Cloth
desc: Dyed silks and velvets for the wealthy.

name: Leaf Tobacco
desc: Taxed, banned, and adored. Prices double where it is outlawed.

name: Old-World Wine
desc: Casks smuggled past the customs men.

name: Gemstones
desc: Never sold in markets, only bought from those who find them.
